unclear.text: Whether unpaid braiding for family and friends is covered.
readings: U1-a: only braiding for pay is covered (assumed)
U1-b: unpaid braiding for family and friends is covered too

a1.text: Few current braiders already hold a cosmetology license, so the requirement binds.

a2.text: The board enforces the requirement often enough that many braiders comply or stop.

a3.text: Some braiders keep working without a license and are not caught.

a8.text: The board's budget is raised for the new enforcement task (appropriation and fees), rather than the task being absorbed within a fixed budget.

a10.text: Some current braiders or new entrants choose to obtain the full license.

a11.text: With fewer braiders offering legal braiding, customers pay a higher price for it.

a12.text: The board absorbs the new enforcement task within a fixed budget, so its other work gives way.
